create.name: Dennis & Kathy Lang
create.bio:
Dennis and Kathy Lang are a married couple who teach yoga, meditation and mindfulness together from Jacksonville, Florida. After more than twenty years in corporate jobs, a first yoga class in 2000 slowly changed the course of their lives, and in 2005 they left those careers to teach full time. Both hold E-RYT 500 certification from the Asheville Yoga Center and are continuing-education providers with Yoga Alliance. Over the years their teachers have included Paul Grilley, Rodney Yee, Seane Corn, Sarah Powers, Shiva Rea and Jivamukti's founders, David Life and Sharon Gannon.

They draw on Kripalu, Jivamukti, Kundalini, yin and vinyasa styles and on the Bhagavad Gita, Patanjali's Yoga Sutras and the Upanishads, chakra theory and Daoist ideas, and call themselves non-denominational yogis. Both are musicians, so a class often closes with live guitar, sitar, flutes, crystal bowls or gong. They run fifteen-hour yin yoga weekend trainings and chakra workshops for studios in Florida and Georgia, lead sound baths and community classes around Jacksonville Beach, and host or co-lead retreats abroad, from Mexico to Greece and Morocco. They co-wrote the book Everything Matters and share free classes, meditations and music online.

courses.title: Yin Yoga Weekend Intensive: Diving Deep into the Stillness
courses.description: A fifteen-hour weekend training, about sixty per cent discussion and forty per cent practice, on the roots of yin yoga, its core postures, meridian theory and how to plan and teach a class, with three ninety-minute practices to live music. Held at host studios (Jacksonville Beach in February 2027 and Vero Beach in March 2027), with Yoga Alliance continuing-education hours.

courses.title: Mexico Wellness Getaway
courses.description: A six-night stay at the Palmaia resort near Playa del Carmen, with oceanfront suites, mostly plant-based meals and a full daily timetable of yoga, meditation, breathwork and sound sessions. Dennis and Kathy teach one of the daily classes and resident teachers lead the rest.
courses.price: From $526 USD per person per night (double occupancy); from $658 USD (single)

courses.title: Myth, Magic & Movement: Amorgos, Greece Retreat
courses.description: A week at the Aegialis Hotel on the Cycladic island of Amorgos, led by Sheila Ewers of SEEK Yoga with Dennis and Kathy as special guests. Mornings start with yoga above the sea, and the days explore Greek myth, village walks and quiet time.

courses.title: Rewiring Your Mind For Sustainable Happiness
courses.description: A ten-day Insight Timer course by Dennis on how thoughts and energy shape happiness, with meditations on mindful use of the senses, living with purpose and resting in presence.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Dennis & Kathy Lang on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Their own instrumental music on sitar, flutes, crystal bowls and chimes, plus guided meditations such as a chakra practice and ocean imagery, free to hear in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Dennis and Kathy Lang on SoundCloud
free_resources.description: Free original music, meditations and playlists from the couple, made to accompany yoga, rest or quiet sitting.

flags: Couple listing: Dennis and Kathy Lang teach as one (shared site, Insight Timer profile, Instagram, YouTube, co-written book), so one listing named for both, slug dennis-and-kathy-lang (the queue named Dennis Lang). The Insight Timer course is credited to Dennis alone.
Email is their shared personal Gmail, published in the footer of every page of their site.
Photo is a joint portrait of the two of them (from their site), not a single-person headshot; no solo headshots were found.

The Greece retreat is run by SEEK Yoga (Sheila Ewers), with Dennis and Kathy as special guests; the Mexico getaway is resort-based, so they teach one class a day and resident teachers do the rest, and prices are per person per night, paid to the resort.
Insight Timer last upload was about a year ago; the YouTube channel has had no uploads for six years, so the videos are older but still evergreen classes.
left_out: Book Everything Matters (Dennis C. and Kathy M. Lang, 2018, ISBN-10 1719441154 per Open Library): amazon.com/dp/1719441154 returned 500 to both curl and WebFetch, and their own site links only an Amazon search, so it could not be checked.
Thai Horizons (Koh Samui, 16–23 Jan 2027) and Enchanted Oasis (Marrakech, 3–10 Apr 2027): both marked SOLD OUT on the organiser's pages.
A Complete Exploration of the Chakras workshop: no dates ('check back'), and its outline includes a 'western medical perspective'.

Into Stillness sound bath (1 Nov 2026) and Thanksgiving class at Bella Vida Yoga (26 Nov 2026): one-off local dates (the first already under way); the Thanksgiving class is on the studio's schedule rather than a page of its own.

YouTube 'Mantra Medicine' series ('medicine' framing, one subtitled 'Corona'), 'Mindful Yoga Practice with Key Points about the Vagus Nerve' (body-health framing), guitar and music-only clips, and short clips under ~5 minutes.
Facebook page linked from their site not counted or listed (not readable without login).
